reviewed_by: the PI (name withheld for double-blind review)
derivation: pipeline_release stage s03_derive_targets, run against the discovery-run expA_logit_lens.json + expB_dla.json for ibp_error (n=10 discovery cases). Same algorithm used to produce Llama's targets.json.

preregistration_notes.check_layer_63_caveat: check_layer=63 is derived from only n=10 discovery cases -- verified NOT to be small-n noise: per-case MLP DLA at L63 was negative in 10/10 cases, mean=-0.167, stdev=0.034 (tight spread). By contrast L79 (det's check layer) was highly erratic on this same IBP data: mean=+0.327, stdev=1.58, only 4/10 cases negative. So L63 is a real, low-noise, but MODEST-MAGNITUDE signal.
preregistration_notes.check_layer_63_success_criterion: Because the effect is modest, held-out success at check_layer=63 is pre-registered with a sign-consistency criterion rather than a large-delta-magnitude criterion: mean MLP DLA at L63 is negative AND >=75% of held-out IBP error cases (n=26) are individually negative at L63. A small-n confidence-interval caveat applies given the held-out IBP error set is itself only n=26.
preregistration_notes.no_sign_matched_patch: IBP has no sign-matched patch replication -- this experiment never existed for ibp_error in the discovery run (no exp_signmatched_patch.json was ever produced for this domain), and additionally IBP has zero plus-writers in the discovery data (10/10 minus-writers), so a sign-matched patch design would have no '+' donor group anyway. This exclusion is intentional, not an oversight.
